##### Project general facts

Emerge Residences is a boutique residential address set within Meydan City, designed to balance contemporary urban living with a calm, retreat-like atmosphere. The architecture combines soft geometry, expansive glazing, and natural stone elements, creating a composition that feels both refined and effortlessly connected to its surroundings. Framed by green corridors and future infrastructure, the development offers a seamless blend of accessibility and privacy, while thoughtfully planned one- to three-bedroom residences feature open layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and a strong emphasis on light, flow, and modern elegance.

The lifestyle at Emerge is centered around wellness and elevated daily living, supported by a curated selection of amenities. At its core is the Elysian Longevity Clubhouse, offering advanced therapies such as cryotherapy, red-light therapy, and hyperbaric oxygen experiences. Residents also benefit from a smart fitness centre, infinity pool, and landscaped outdoor areas designed for relaxation and movement. Additional features including shaded jogging paths, social spaces, and integrated retail and F&B concepts create a holistic environment where well-being, leisure, and community naturally come together.

Interiors are finished with high-quality materials, combining travertine flooring, refined textures, and a clean contemporary palette with integrated smart home systems for enhanced comfort and control. Kitchens are fully equipped with premium appliances, offering both functionality and sleek design, while spa-inspired bathrooms and ensuite layouts elevate everyday living. Select residences include private pools, outdoor saunas, and cold plunges, adding a bespoke wellness dimension. The homes are offered unfurnished, providing flexibility for personalization within a thoughtfully designed and sophisticated framework.

##### Location description and benefits

Meydan City is an extraordinary community situated in the heart of Dubai, known for its blend of luxury, sophistication, and world-class amenities. Spanning over a vast area, Meydan City offers a unique living experience that combines urban convenience with a tranquil and scenic environment.

One of the standout features of Meydan City is its iconic Meydan Racecourse, which hosts renowned horse racing events, including the prestigious Dubai World Cup. The racecourse creates an aura of excitement and elegance, attracting enthusiasts from around the world. Residents of Meydan City have the privilege of witnessing the thrilling races firsthand and immersing themselves in the vibrant atmosphere that surrounds this prestigious venue.

Green spaces are integral to the design of Meydan City, with expansive parks, landscaped gardens, and tree-lined boulevards adorning the community. Residents can enjoy leisurely walks, bike rides, or picnics in these serene surroundings, offering a refreshing escape from the bustling city life. The abundance of open spaces also provides opportunities for outdoor activities and social gatherings, fostering a sense of community and well-being.
